lm.notes: SharedPreferences 'lm': the launcher's source of truth. On every game start (MyGame.onCreate -> GameSettings.write) the launcher rewrites the [video], [rendering], [audio], [enhancements] and [gameplay] keys of settings.ini from these prefs, so edit the prefs, not the ini. Force-stop before editing (the app commits on change).

ini.notes: Engine config (Key=Value without spaces, [sections]). Keys the launcher does not manage (e.g. [controls]) survive; managed keys are overwritten at each start: target_fps, unlimited_fps=false, match_display_refresh=false, resolution_scale, msaa, vsync, display_copy_filter, texture_copy_filter, aspect, hud_keep_4x3, master/music/sfx_volume, reverb, show_fps, damage_scale, health_scale, ghost_health_scale, vacuum_strength, always_ride, mirror_world, skip_cutscenes. DLC engine uses files/xdg_dlc/Luigi's Mansion Recompiled/.

fps.label: Options > Graphics > Frame Rate
fps.notes: Choices = 30, 60, plus each display refresh rate between 62 and 240 Hz (120 added if none). Written to settings.ini [video] target_fps, capped at 60 by Performance Mode and lowered by Auto Cool-down when hot. First launch picks a device-tier preset (60 on mid/high tiers) unless g_fps/g_res/g_msaa/g_perf already exist. From the APK (versionCode 3); not checked against a written file.
